name: Beginnings Restaurant
description: A book-themed gastropub on Park Street in Atlantic Beach with a wall of bookshelves. It is known for themed tasting dinners, trivia and craft nights, and has acoustic live music on some Sunday evenings.

dancing.notes: Live music here is occasional: acoustic Sunday Session sets from about 5 to 8 PM, plus some themed nights. Most events are reserved, sit-down dinners. We found no sign of a dance floor or of people dancing.

evidence.note: The restaurant's calendar: mostly themed dinners, trivia and DIY nights, with Sunday Session live music by solo or duo acts.
Reservation page describing a casual-elegant gastropub with a literary theme; good for groups.
A diner review mentions coming for a Pearl Jam themed night and suggests booking ahead.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05) for source beginnings-restaurant-atlantic-beach. Music is occasional and most events are seated themed dinners; floor and policy are a guess.
